statement:
I'll look up the booking first to see what the record says.
The record gives the side as **left**, which contradicts both Mr Adeyemi's instruction and Ms Farrell's signed consent form naming the **right** knee — so I am booking the right side, since operating on a healthy left knee would be a wrong-site surgery.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the record's "left" side "contradicts" the surgeon and consent naming the right knee and would be "wrong-site surgery," giving the correct value.
